history.summary: A 1,259 sqft freehold 3BR at Sunhaven (D16 Upper Changi/Bedok, built 2003), 750m from DT34 Upper Changi MRT, at $1.85M / $1,469 psf. Strong realized appreciation (5.74%/yr over a solid 49-txn series) and a $1.85M quantum right in the deep-liquidity band make this a credible 3BR investment; freehold removes lease-decay risk despite the 2003 build, though asking PSF is ~6% above the $1,392 median.
history.rating_rationale: A well-evidenced 5.74%/yr CAGR on 49 transactions, freehold 3BR (no lease decay), $1.85M in the deepest liquidity band, and a strong arena record (Elo 1611, 447-122-0) line up well. D16 benefits from the DT line, Bayshore precinct development and Upper East Coast/TEL theme. The ~6% PSF premium to median and the 2003 age (dated facilities) are the trade-offs, but freehold + family-sized 3BR + documented growth justify a Buy.
red_flags: Built 2003 — older facilities, higher maintenance than newer stock
750m to MRT — decent but not doorstep
catalysts: Freehold 3BR at $1.85M — family-sized unit in the deepest liquidity band
Documented 5.74%/yr appreciation on a credible 49-txn series
D16 Bayshore precinct development + DT34 Upper Changi / Upper East Coast TEL theme
